replies.author: @VagariousTravel-868
replies.text: ood question. The short answer is yes, you generally still owe property taxes and your mortgage, even if lava destroys your home. But there are relief programs. In Hawaii, for example, homeowners can apply for disaster relief to get their assessed value reduced to zero for the next tax year. The mortgage doesn't disappear either. You still owe the bank, but you can ask for forbearance to pause payments temporarily. It's a tough situation, but there are steps people can take
